findings.title: ci script duplicated across quick, story and release
findings.detail:
The release ci run block is a verbatim copy of quick.yaml:60-67 (and story). A later change to how CI is awaited must be made three times. Workflows have no include mechanism, so this is the accepted pattern for now.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: None needed now; consider a shared script under scripts/ if the ci check changes again.
